## Outcome and scope

- Observable behaviour and accepted scope reference
- Invocation, output and exit code, when applicable
- Compatibility and non-goals
- Architecture impact and relevant LikeC4/decision links
- Dependencies and unresolved decisions

## Acceptance evidence

- Success scenario
- Failure, partial success or recovery scenario
- Confirmation rejection produces no mutation, and no-prompt execution reads no input, where applicable
- Required unit and integration coverage
- Exact validation commands under PROJECT.md
- Live target approval, fixture prerequisites, serialisation and cleanup evidence, or reason live checks are unnecessary
- README/help and PR release notes for operator workflow changes

## Ready decision

- Owner's scope agreement and resolved dependencies
- Operator experience impact and required local walkthrough
- Independent review scope
- Publication authority and any human hold
- Budget override, or PROJECT.md defaults

An issue is ready when its material decisions are resolved and the task fits PROJECT.md. Completing this form grants no publication, merge or release authority.
